<!--
  A post as a card: cover picture, category, title, excerpt, author line and a read link. Axes: layout
  (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), meta (full, short: the date only, news: date and title only),
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";

export type PostCardProps = {
  post: Post;
  labels: PostLabels;
  layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  meta?: "full" | "short" | "news";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Card from "../primitives/card/card.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  post,
  labels,
  layout = "vertical",
  media = "image",
  meta = "full",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<PostCardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Box v-if="((meta as string) === 'news')"
    :class="cn(
      'flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded p-0 inset-ring inset-ring-border',
      defaults.news.card
    )"
    data-testid="item"
    :data-layout="layout"
    data-meta="news"
  >
    <Box :class="cn('relative shrink-0 overflow-hidden', defaults.news.cover)" data-testid="news-cover">
      <MediaFrame :alt="post.title" ratio="16/9" :class="cn('size-full', defaults.media.rounded)" />
      <Title
        :as="3"
        size="xs"
        weight="semibold"
        :class="cn(
          'pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-12 line-clamp-2 text-center leading-5 text-foreground',
          defaults.news.title
        )"
        data-testid="news-title"
      >
        {{ post.title }}
      </Title>
    </Box>
    <Group
      gap="2"
      align="center"
      :class="cn('w-full px-2 text-muted-foreground', defaults.news.strip)"
      data-testid="news-date"
    >
      <LucideIcon name="calendar" :size="16" />
      <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
        {{ post.date }}
      </Text>
      <Text v-if="post.category" size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
        {{ post.category }}
      </Text>
    </Group>
  </Box>
  <Card v-else
    variant="default"
    :class="cn(
      'h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden',
      (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row' : 'flex flex-col')
    )"
    data-testid="item"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :data-meta="meta"
  >
    <Box
      v-if="((media as string) === 'image')"
      :class="cn('relative shrink-0', (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'sm:w-64' : ''))"
    >
      <MediaFrame :alt="post.title" ratio="16/9" class="h-full" />
    </Box>
    <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
      <Group v-if="((meta as string) !== 'news')" gap="2" align="center">
        <LucideIcon :name="post.icon" :size="16" />
        <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
          {{ post.category }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
        {{ post.title }}
      </Title>
      <Text
        v-if="(((density as string) === 'default') && ((meta as string) !== 'news'))"
        size="sm"
        class="text-muted-foreground"
      >
        {{ post.excerpt }}
      </Text>
      <Group v-if="((meta as string) !== 'news')" gap="2" class="mt-auto flex-wrap pt-2 text-muted-foreground">
        <Text v-if="((meta as string) === 'full')" size="xs">
          {{ tpl(labels.by, post.author) }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs">
          {{ post.date }}
        </Text>
        <Text v-if="((meta as string) === 'full')" size="xs">
          {{ tpl(labels.minutes, post.minutes) }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Link v-if="((meta as string) !== 'news')" href="#/" variant="default" data-testid="read">
        {{ labels.read }}
      </Link>
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
</template>
